name: WB Manufacturing (formerly Wisconsin Bench)
old_description: Our new Lookbook brings together inspiring environments and solutions designed to support how students learn today.
about:
WB Manufacturing, headquartered in Thorp, Wisconsin, operates as a manufacturer of furniture and architectural casework for educational and commercial settings. The company, formerly known as Wisconsin Bench, provides design, fabrication, and delivery services from its Thorp facility.

The product line includes standard cabinets and lockers, modular casework, mobile furniture, and custom solutions tailored to specific spaces. An in-house design team works with CET design software to render rooms and integrate product specifications. The company also offers a Build & Hold program for project staging, project registration, and continuing education credit (CEU) opportunities for design professionals.

WB Manufacturing primarily serves the education sector, including K‑12 schools, higher‑education institutions, and specialized learning environments such as STEAM labs, media centers, and art rooms. Recent projects include Paso Verde STEAM School in Sacramento, California, and Tomahawk Elementary in the Shawnee Mission School District. The company also markets its capabilities to broader commercial markets, emphasizing flexibility for any environment.

The company positions its in‑house design team and ability to handle both fixed and mobile installations as key differentiators. Its Build & Hold program allows customers to stage deliveries to match construction schedules, and the design team can import room dimensions directly into CET to furnish spaces virtually. WB Manufacturing emphasizes a "Design. Build. Deliver." approach, aiming to provide end‑to‑end service from concept through installation.
